deprecation.message: This version was published with an unsupported pre-release composition and source metadata that does not match the intended public-source distribution. Do not install or use it. A verified replacement will be published after source, dependency, licensing, and signing review.

description: Healthcare data generation, validation, and testing platform. Generate synthetic HL7, FHIR, and NCPDP messages for safe integration testing.
releaseNotes: v1.0.0 — Full HL7 v2.3 generation (ADT, ORM, ORU, RDE, ADR, VXU, SIU, MDM, DFT, BAR), FHIR R4 (24 resource types), NCPDP SCRIPT 2017071, validation engine, HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification, vendor pattern detection, session-based patient context, and embedded terminology datasets (LOINC, ICD-10, NDC, CVX, SNOMED CT).
